title: P-only homotopy shrinking
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], P a cochain complex of O_Y-modules [def-pc-derived-category] supported in [0,d], d≥0, with every term finite free [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Let y∈V for an open V of Y, and fix endomorphisms a,b of P restricted to V. Suppose their termwise pullbacks [def-pc-derived-pullback] along V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV are homotopic. Then there are W≤V containing y and a homotopy between the restrictions of these fixed maps a,b to W.

source.place: Proof, first two paragraphs: local unit-entry cancellation and extension of the finite calculation; finite matrix homotopy identities after shrinking

proof.text: Choose the prescribed stalk homotopy h. Apply exists_lift_reverse_components to h.hom and h.zero, giving U<=V, a comparison e natural on all cochain complexes on V, and reverse-degree components k with the component conjugacy equations. No homotopy equation has yet been imposed on k.

Mathlib map_nullHomotopicMap, nullHomotopicMap_comp and comp_nullHomotopicMap convert the component conjugacies to S(nullHomotopicMap k)=e.hom ; nullHomotopicMap(h.hom) ; e.inv. The homotopy comm equations show T(a-b)=nullHomotopicMap(h.hom). Naturality of e on the fixed chain map a-b and cancellation of e.hom therefore show that the stalk pullbacks of R(a-b) and nullHomotopicMap k are equal. This is proved degreewise using sub_eq_iff_eq_add and h.comm.

Apply exists_shrink_chainMap_eq_of_stalk to these two chain maps on U. Obtain W<=U containing y and equality of their restrictions. The explicitly constructed Mathlib nullHomotopy k hkzero, mapped along restriction and transported along that equality, is a null homotopy of the restricted difference a-b. Homotopy.equivSubZero converts it to a homotopy of the twice-restricted a and b.

Cancel V.ι to prove that Y.homOfLE(W<=U) followed by Y.homOfLE(U<=V) is Y.homOfLE(W<=V). Mathlib restrictFunctorCongr and restrictFunctorComp give a natural isomorphism between direct and successive restrictions. Transport the homotopy by precomposition with its hom and postcomposition with its inv; naturality on a and b and hom/inv cancellation identify the endpoints with their direct restrictions. Return W and the transitive inclusion W<=V. The proved private helper homotopyOfNaturalIso performs precisely this transport.

proof_origin.place: N1 compiling reduction of the existing three-step finite matrix plan: reverse-component lifting, local equality of chain maps, Mathlib null-homotopy construction and natural-iso transport. Original statement unchanged.

theorem exists_shrink_homotopy_P_of_stalk
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (P : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ) (d : ℕ)
    (hge : P.IsStrictlyGE 0) (hle : P.IsStrictlyLE d)
    (hfree : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ s : ℕ, Nonempty
      (P.X n ≅ SheafOfModules.free (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) (ULift.{u} (Fin s))))
    (y : Y) (V : Y.Opens) (hyV : y ∈ V)
    (a b : (((restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P) ⟶
      (((restrictFunctor V.ι).mapHomologicalComplex _).obj P))
    (hP : Nonempty (Homotopy
      (((Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).mapHomologicalComplex _).map a)
      (((Modules.pullback (V.fromSpecStalkOfMem y hyV)).mapHomologicalComplex _).map b))) :
    ∃ (W : Y.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ V), y ∈ W ∧
      Nonempty (Homotopy
        (((restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE hWV)).mapHomologicalComplex _).map a)
        (((restrictFunctor (Y.homOfLE hWV)).mapHomologicalComplex _).map b))
